## Retrospective

Learnings captured:
1. For pytest plugin defaults, combine static pyproject assertions with a bounded subprocess test that exercises the plugin using a short override.
2. When adding dev tools in this repo, update both [project.optional-dependencies].dev and [dependency-groups].dev because separate uv install paths read separate tables.
3. Copilot CLI can be unavailable due to quota, so implementation must fall back to direct TDD while documenting the degraded mode.
